'''Thomas Bourgeron''' is a French scientist working at the [[Institut Pasteur]]. His group discovered the first monogenic mutations involved in [[autism]].<ref>{{cite journal  |vauthors=Durand CM, Betancur C, Boeckers TM, etal |title=Mutations in the gene encoding the synaptic scaffolding protein SHANK3 are associated with autism spectrum disorders |journal=Nat. Genet. |volume=39 |issue=1 |pages=25–7 |year=2007 |pmid=17173049 |pmc=2082049 |doi=10.1038/ng1933 |url=http://www.hal.inserm.fr/inserm-00126175/document}}</ref> He is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-B/thomas-bourgeron.html|title=Académie des sciences|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> He works on genes, changes in synapse properties and changes in circadian rhythm in autism-spectrum disorders.
